schema: CREATE TABLE notes(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,title TEXT NOT NULL,score INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

queries.name: edit
queries.sql: UPDATE notes SET title=?,score=? WHERE id=?

queries.name: list
queries.sql: SELECT id,title,score FROM notes ORDER BY id

queries.name: get
queries.sql: SELECT id,title,score FROM notes WHERE id=?

queries.name: count
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM notes
